# unifi_access_policy (Data Source)

Look up a UniFi Access policy by `id` (`unique_id`) or `name` (read-only). **Modeled from the reverse-engineered Access API and not yet verified against a live console — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Access object id (`unique_id`). Provide `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Policy display name. Provide `name` or `id`. If multiple policies share a name, the first match wins.

### Read-Only

- `creator_name` (String) Name of the policy creator.
- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `door_count` (Number) Number of doors granted.
- `elevator_count` (Number) Number of elevators granted.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active.
- `group_count` (Number) Number of door groups granted.
- `user_count` (Number) Number of users the policy applies to.
- `valid_end_time` (String) Policy validity window end.
- `valid_start_time` (String) Policy validity window start.
